neighbours.label: the continuation piece of a rare name after an opening As-, Ag- or Ar- syllable (Ash|ken|azi, Ag|ass|iz, Ag|assi, Ar|akan, Are|z|ki, Ars|ene), as opposed to other names in the same frames
fire: Her Ashkenazi grandparents came from Poland.
The book cites Agassiz on glaciers.
A talk by Shai Agassi was posted.
Burma lost the coast of Arakan.
quiet: Her Polish grandparents came from Poland.
The book cites Darwin on glaciers.
A talk by Elon Musk was posted.
Burma lost the coast of Bengal.

notes: This is a word-level list. The opening syllable is a pattern read from the card; other names with these openings are not tested.
